nodes.name: Architecture & Data Contracts
nodes.prompt_template: Architect the module boundaries, Pydantic data schemas, and API contracts for the feature.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify data contracts and Pydantic schemas exist and are syntactically valid.

nodes.name: Parallel Module Implementation
nodes.prompt_template: Implement the core logic and functions adhering strictly to data schemas created in node_01.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Run py_compile / node --check on implemented modules.

nodes.name: Unit & Integration Test Suite
nodes.prompt_template: Write comprehensive pytest / Jest unit and integration tests covering green and red paths.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Execute test suite and verify 100% pass rate.

nodes.name: Code Review & Walkthrough
nodes.prompt_template: Conduct a 5-axis code review (correctness, readability, architecture, security, performance) and generate walkthrough.md.

verification_gate.verifier_prompt: Verify walkthrough.md and EVIDENCE.md exist with valid output logs.
